messages:
nina c: quick heads up from canary logs: we're seeing a ~1.9% bump in fncall validation rejects that appear as 502s in the console. Customers are confused and support is getting pings. sample below.

sam y: sample payload from logs:
```json
{
  "command": "set_temp",
  "value": "72"
}
```
contract expects `{\"command\": {\"name\": \"set_temp\", \"params\": {\"value\": 72}}` — model returned simplified shape.

kevin m: Thanks. This is from validator-v2 canary with enforce=true on 10% slice. We toggled it to measure enforcement FP rate. Looks like FP is higher than expected for these simple commands.

sana r: Two urgent things: (1) Console UX: don't show opaque 502s. Show collapsed raw output + reason (expected path) and a one-click "retry with permissive" for customers to test. (2) Billing: we charged tokens for these rejects; we should not bill if final_delivery=false.

nina c: Agreed. Proposals: add telemetry tags `validation_outcome`=ok|soft_reject|hard_reject, `final_delivery`=true|false, `sanitizer_applied`=true|false. Billing job can drop lines where final_delivery=false and validation_outcome=hard_reject.

kevin m: Routing proposal: try light-local sanitizer first (cheap transforms), then permissive_variant, then enforced_variant. Make order configurable per-route. Also add `coerce_on_read` where validator attempts non-destructive coercions and marks `coerced=true` — deliver result and surface in console.

sana r: For console, implement a compact detail panel: validator_status, raw_output (collapsed), diff against expected schema, and a "resend relaxed" button which hits permissive_variant and shows the permissive response inline. Also add graphs: `validation_reject_rate`, `coerced_rate`, `sanitizer_success_rate`, and `billing_credits_pending`.

sam y: Implementation notes: sanitizer will support three ops: wrap_scalar_to_object, array_to_items_object, numeric_string_to_number. Attach a short `sanitizer_patch` string in telemetry when applied. Keep sanitizer max ops=2 by default.

kevin m: I'll open a small PR to change routing and emit the new telemetry tags. Nina, can you take billing backfill + a playbook entry for credits (cap to 30 days, manual review if >$1k/day)? Sana, can you mock the console panel and the resend-relaxed flow? Sam, can you own sanitizer implementation and telemetry patch format?

nina c: I will. Playbook sketch: if hard_reject_rate>0.5% for 10m -> page oncall. Auto-queue credits for review if total queued >$250/day. Manual review required before issuing credits over $1k/day.

sana r: For rollout safety, enable sanitizer sampling=15% and coerce_on_read sampling=10% in canary. If coerced_rate>2% and support tickets fall, expand. Add an automatic rollback if hard_reject_rate>1% for 5m.

kevin m: ops-bot can we schedule the canary changes?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-05 02:15 UTC. Changes: validator-v2: coerce_on_read=canary(10%), sanitizer=canary(15%), routing_order=sanitizer->permissive->enforce. Owners: kevin m, sam y. Link: https://deploys.internal/6555554321

nina c: I'll post a 24h metrics follow-up. Thanks everyone.
